title: Bin El Ouidane reservoir on 16 Jul 2026
summary: On 16 Jul 2026 the radar shows a lake of 33.83 km2 inside the 10 km circle around Bin El Ouidane. No flag applies, but 17.1% of the lake outline falls on land in the optical photo, so this lake figure deserves extra care.

sections.heading: What the radar shows here
sections.text: Open water averages -17.61 dB in HH and -22.75 dB in HV, still far darker than the circle mean of -7.97 dB in HH and -14.26 dB in HV. The lake method measures 33.83 km2 of water, more than the 30.46 km2 open water type drawn from the whole season.

sections.heading: Terrain types and what they mean
sections.text: Trees, shrub and rugged slopes cover 192.98 km2, 61.4% of the circle, and give the brightest HV of the large types, -12.76 dB, from leaves and branches. Rough dry ground and fields, 24.0%, return medium echoes from soil and stones. Built-up land, 1.8%, has the lowest HV:HH ratio, -13.26 dB, from walls that bounce the pulse straight back.

sections.heading: Data quality notes
sections.text: No flag applies to this date. Still, 17.1% of the radar lake outline falls on land in the optical photo. Possible cause: dark slopes or radar shadow joined to the lake mask on this date. Possible cause: a higher water level than in the photo. The dam's level record for this date would tell the two apart.
